subject: A small web experiment for a maker of web toys
text:
Hi Tim,

I saw the Optical Toys and One Square Minesweeper projects on your site. The idea of making something playful out of a single page is why I wanted to show you this.

I built Take The Wall: one public page with one featured owner. Your project replaces the current content and stays until somebody else takes over.

Would you be interested in trying it with One Square Minesweeper? Browsing and previewing are free; publishing a takeover costs $3.99. It’s an early experiment, with no guaranteed audience or duration.

Here’s the page: https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=personal&utm_medium=outreach&utm_campaign=first_owners&utm_content=tim-holman

No need to reply if it’s not your thing — I won’t send a follow-up sequence.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
